description.p: FastViz is a minimal, very fast photo and video browser. It opens large folders of photos and clips instantly, even on slow or external drives, and keeps a thumbnail cache so folders you have visited before show up at once.

ul.li: Folder tree and a thumbnail grid that stays smooth with tens of thousands of files
Fullscreen viewer with zoom, and the next and previous items preloaded
JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP, TIFF, HEIC/HEIF and AVIF photos, and nearly any video format
Sort by name, date, date taken, format, dimensions or size; shuffle; show only pictures or videos
Cut, copy, paste, rename and move to Trash with undo, working together with Files
Thumbnail padding now sets the space between columns too, not only between rows
The folder tree lists Documents, Pictures and the other folders in Home, and every drive and phone, like Files; drives that aren't mounted yet mount when opened
If the folder FastViz opens at startup is on a drive that isn't mounted yet, the drive is mounted first
Larger app icon, closer in size to other apps in the taskbar
